Mop Baddies, Hang Out, Get Money

Controls: 
• E = STOMP: Stomp on down players to whoop them.
• F = PULL HAIR: Charge your blue bar by hitting others and press F to get people bald 
• G = CARRY PEOPLE: Step on a downed player and press G to carry them. 
• Shift = RUN • Fists Tool: Equip your fists to hit people. 

Hitting someone while stepping on someone will mop them. 

IMPORTANT: If you log with 30 HP or less you lose your weapons.

• Character Customization: Click the avatar icon in the top-right corner of the screen to customize your Avatar. 
• Get Money: Smash ATMs around the map to collect cash. 
• Pick Up Fight Items: Find various items scattered across the map to use in fights.
